Antigravity pre-review (Claude Opus 5.5 via Antigravity; not a collaborator review; no marker) @ e43a06a82d89b4552e8423e94bbd2bb13dc777e3

**Verdict: FINDINGS (2)**

The row itself is accurate. I checked it against `crates/app/src/mcp/stock_fit_tools.rs`, `setup_tools::opt_nums` and `crates/app/src/stock_fit.rs`. The defaults, mm, side order, box-only `sides`, parts-only rule, kept rotation, one `SetStock` undo and the refusals all match the code.

### Findings

1. **PR body: no `Process change: yes` line** (AGENTS.md:295, `.claude/agents/PR-reviewer.md:169`, `.claude/skills/review-prs/SKILL.md:234`).
   `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` is a process file. The body says the merging session must announce on #681, but it does not carry the exact line. Failure case: the final reviewer must ask for changes, and a merge batch that looks for the line can skip the `process-bump` and the #681 note, so forks never pull the new row.

2. **`xtask/tests/fit_stock_skill.rs:1`: the pin sits where it rarely runs and blocks the runner.**
   - `xtask/src/quick.rs:62` runs the xtask tests only when `xtask/` changes. Failure case: a later PR that edits only `SKILL.md` and drops or rewords the row passes `gate quick` without running this pin.
   - `.github/workflows/pr-test.yml:121` refuses any PR that touches `xtask/` ("read, not built"). So this docs-only PR cannot use the PR-test runner and has to be built locally.
   - The pin reads only the doc (`include_str!`), never the tool schema. If someone changes the default margin or the side order in `stock_fit_tools.rs`, the pin stays green while the doc is wrong.
   This is a design point for the final reviewer, not a blocker. One option: drop the pin and leave a docs-only PR.

### Nit (not counted)
- `SKILL.md:110`: the refusal list leaves out `SetStock`'s size cap. A very large `margin` (for example 1e9) is refused with "stock dimensions exceed ...". This comes from `commands/set_stock.rs:56`, through `stock_fit::fit_command`'s "stock not fitted: ...".

### Results (PR merged locally with upstream/main 058e14c, clean merge)
- `cargo test -p xtask --test fit_stock_skill`: **pass** (1/1).
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: **green** (xtask unit tests ok, 76 s, 0 failed).
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: **clean**.
- Mutation: I restored upstream's `SKILL.md` (row removed). The pin went **RED** ("the MCP skill must list fit_stock in its tool reference"). I put the row back and the tree was clean again.
- AGENTS.md checks: no unwrap/expect/panic outside tests (the `expect` is in a test). Every file is well under 400 lines. No golden, snapshot PNG, PROCESS_VERSION, Cargo dependency, `.github` or `scripts` change. The body has `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #1552`. The decision file follows `docs/decisions/README.md`.
- Untested case: this change is documentation only, so it cannot gouge, crash or change posted G-code. The real risk is an agent misreading the contract. I traced the edge cases in code: `sides` with an unknown shape is refused as "fits a box only", and `margin` together with `sides` is parsed but ignored. Both fit the row's wording.

Addressed both pre-review findings.

1. Added the exact `Process change: yes` line to the PR body. Temporary check `process_change_marker` failed with the line removed and passed after restoration.
2. Removed the xtask documentation-only pin, taking the suggested docs-only option. Temporary check `docs_only_no_xtask_pin` failed with the test restored and passed after removal. The decision ledger records this choice.

Quick gate passed against `upstream/main`: docs-only diff, no crate tests selected, zero failed steps. Xtask clippy passed with all targets and warnings denied.

New head: `ebe241412af5d6c0879311fdba6bc4f540fa5b44`.

Please re-review this head.

Antigravity pre-review (Claude Opus 5.5 via Antigravity; not a collaborator review; no marker) @ ebe241412af5d6c0879311fdba6bc4f540fa5b44

**Verdict: FINDINGS** (2, both minor doc gaps; neither blocks the merge)

I checked the new row against `crates/app/src/mcp/stock_fit_tools.rs`, `crates/app/src/stock_fit.rs`, `opt_nums` in `setup_tools.rs` and `SetStock::new`. These match the code: the parameters, the `box` default, `margin` 2 mm, the side order [-X, +X, -Y, +Y, -Z, +Z], `sides` with box only, parts only, rotation kept, one `SetStock` undo step, and the `{ stock }` response.

## Findings

1. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:110`: the list of refusals leaves out the size-cap refusal. A call like `fit_stock { "margin": 600000 }` gets past every check in `stock_fit::fitted`. Then `SetStock::new` refuses it with "stock not fitted: stock dimensions exceed 1000000 mm" (`MAX_STOCK_DIM`, `crates/geometry/src/geometry/stock.rs:22`). The same happens with very large `sides`. This refusal is safe; it is just not listed. Suggested fix: add "or a fitted stock over the size limit" to the list.
2. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md:108`: the section heading lists `tools.rs`, `edit.rs`, `body_tools.rs` and #355, #361. The new row's code is in `stock_fit_tools.rs` (#1538), which the heading does not name. An agent that uses the heading to find the source will look in the wrong file. Suggested fix: add `stock_fit_tools.rs` to the heading.

Nit, no action needed: with an unknown `shape` and `sides` together, the reply is "\"sides\" fits a box only", not the unknown-shape refusal. The call is still refused by name.

## Results

- Tests named in the body: none can be run. The body says its review-fix checks were temporary and are not in the tree.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, on PR head merged with upstream/main locally: **green**. 2 files changed, docs-only plan, 0 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: **green**. No crate under `crates/` was touched.
- Mutations: **N/A**. The PR adds no code guard. It changes only a skill doc row and a decision file.
- AGENTS.md checks: no code, so there is no unwrap, expect or panic to check. No snapshot PNG, `PROCESS_VERSION`, Cargo dependency, `.github` or `scripts` change. No golden moved. The body has `Process change: yes`, `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #1552`. The decision file is `docs/decisions/1552-fit-stock-skill.md`, as required.
- Uncovered case I looked at: a very large margin or `sides` value (finding 1). From the code, it is refused before any stock is set, so it cannot gouge or post wrong G-code. Only the documentation is missing it.

Codex pre-review (not a collaborator review; no marker) @ ebe241412af5d6c0879311fdba6bc4f540fa5b44

Verdict CLEAN.

No findings. The fit_stock row matches the shipped schema and implementation. Both changed files are under 400 lines. No runtime code, goldens, dependencies, snapshot PNGs, PROCESS_VERSION, .github or scripts changed. The body has Changelog:, Fixes #1552 and Process change: yes.

Local merge with upstream/main succeeded.
Quick gate: GREEN, docs-only plan, 0 steps, 0 failures.
Clippy: GREEN for xtask, all targets, warnings denied.
Both cargo commands used CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1.
Temporary-check reproduction: exact process marker and no xtask changes PASS; in-memory negative controls reject a changed marker and an xtask path. The original temporary scripts are not committed, so those exact scripts could not be rerun.
Mutations: N/A. This PR adds no runtime guards or pins.

Additional safety case considered: a negative margin with valid sides. The implementation uses sides instead of the margin, as documented. A non-finite margin is still rejected by the parser. No new runtime behavior is introduced.
Additional runtime check: cargo test -p camcraft-app --test stock_fit_fixtures passed all 10 tests, including asymmetric allowances, aligned setups, fixture exclusion, rotation and undo.
